title: Benchmark output checksum

degradation.apply:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/lib.rs'; s=open(p).read()
anchor='    top\n}\n'
assert s.count(anchor)==1, 'degradation anchor not found exactly once'
s=''+s.replace(anchor,'    top.into_iter().rev().collect()\n}\n',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

gaming_risks: outputs could be hard-coded for the exact bench seed and size
the checksum depends on SB_SEED and SB_BENCH_SIZE: compare only against a baseline measured with the same env
